newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly higher.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open slightly firmer Thursday in line with LME copper which was recovering for a third session from Monday's sharp correction to a month-long rally.
March copper was called to open up 0.20 to 0.30 cent from Wednesday's close of 101.75 cents a lb. It traded in a range of 101.50 to 102.30 cents on ACCESS.
COMEX copper warehouse fell 2,536 short tons Wednesday to 31,657 short tons.
The prompt market remains tight, traders said, although the backwardation narrowed this week.
